description:
[Taxonomy VII.121 — baseline response (public data only)] Build a denial-response package tailored to the denial reason code.

WHEN TO USE: User has a denied claim and wants to appeal, or is preparing arguments / evidence / escalation steps for one.

WHEN NOT: For explaining what a denial code means without drafting an appeal, use denial_code_explainer first. For finding a negotiation path on a non-denied bill, use negotiate_bill_script.

EXAMPLES:
- Build response package for CO-197: `{"denial_reason":"CO-197","insurer":"Aetna","cpt_code":"45378","amount":1850}`
name: denial_response_builder
